items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The transcript shows the INTERVIEWER narrating a story about King Oliver and Louis Metcalf ('Louis Metcalf played the trumpet part... That was the first recording ever I made in my life'). The interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not speak in the provided context, nor does the interviewer attribute

ctx.x: 1928 right here in New York but he couldn't play. He had pyorrhea and Louis Metcalf played the trumpet part. That was the first recording ever I made in my life.
If Louis Metcalf played the trumpet, what did King Oliver do?
